title: Break to teleport
description: this is a data pack that teleports you to an area whenever you break a block.
body:
# Break to Teleport

Break to Teleport is a Minecraft Java Edition datapack that replaces normal movement with teleportation. Players cannot move using standard controls. Instead, breaking a block instantly teleports the player to the nearest dropped item within a 4 block radius. Every step forward requires mining, turning exploration, survival, and progression into a unique challenge.

## Features

- Disables normal player movement.
- Detects when a player mines a block.
- Teleports the player to the nearest dropped item within a 4 block radius.
- Plays an Enderman style teleport sound after every teleport.
- Runs automatically every game tick.
- Lightweight with minimal performance impact.
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.
- Compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 1.13 and above.

## Installation

1. Download the datapack.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or rejoin the world.
4. Mine blocks to move.

## Challenge

- Normal walking is disabled.
- Mining is your only way to travel.
- Every block becomes a movement decision.
- Perfect for challenge runs, survival worlds, speedruns, and content creation.
